why: A high-signal motion reference that keeps its craft in the DOM: custom cursor inversion, animated loader, menu overlay, reel sections, postcard flips, CTA ripples, and repeated autoplay media all work together as one branded interaction system.

compositions.title: Brand and capability reels
compositions.study: Repeated reel sections turn logos, services, and social links into kinetic strips rather than static logo farms.
compositions.reuse: Use when repeated content should feel alive without becoming decorative noise.

compositions.title: Postcard service stack
compositions.study: Service content is structured as front/back postcard cards so motion can reveal more depth without leaving the page.
compositions.reuse: Use when hover or tap should expose a second information layer inside the same section.

compositions.title: Typographic loader overlay
compositions.study: The loader is treated as a branded scene with oversized typography instead of a generic spinner.
compositions.reuse: Make wait states part of the visual system when the site sells craft.

assets.notes: The page uses many autoplay, muted video loops across achievements, icon moments, and footer background.
assets.reuse: Break video into small narrative loops instead of relying on one massive hero clip.

assets.notes: Matter and Gallery Modern create contrast between operational copy and expressive headlines.
assets.reuse: Use two-role typography systems when motion design needs both clarity and theater.

assets.role: card fronts, reels, and footer stage
assets.notes: Images and video are attached to multiple modules rather than isolated in one showcase section.
assets.reuse: Distribute media across the scroll so every chapter has its own movement vocabulary.

motion.title: Word-by-word loader reveal
motion.notes: The loader overlay uses oversized words, percent progress, and fill transitions to pace entry into the site.
motion.fallback: Reduced-motion handling was not verified, so keep this as inspiration-only until a live follow-up confirms it.

motion.title: Full-screen menu transition
motion.notes: Navigation expands into a fixed overlay instead of acting like a simple dropdown or topbar.
motion.fallback: When motion is reduced, the overlay should still preserve direct access to every destination.

motion.title: Micro-looped media throughout the scroll
motion.notes: Video loops are embedded in multiple sections so motion energy stays distributed instead of front-loaded.
motion.fallback: Each loop should degrade to a clear poster frame or still image.

motion.title: Cursor polarity shifts
motion.notes: Multiple sections switch to an inverse cursor mode to turn the pointer into part of the visual language.
motion.fallback: Pointer styling should remain optional for touch devices and non-pointer environments.

interactions.title: Inverse cursor zones
interactions.study: Sections explicitly declare inverse cursor behavior, so the pointer acts like a scene element rather than a neutral browser arrow.
interactions.reuse: Use cursor styling sparingly to mark interaction mode shifts, not every hover target.

interactions.title: Cinematic navigation drawer
interactions.study: The nav toggle opens a full-screen menu with its own layout and reveal rhythm.
interactions.reuse: Use when the menu should feel like entering another chapter instead of covering the page with a utility tray.

interactions.title: Postcard front/back reveal
interactions.study: Cards present a media front and a text-heavy back, which makes hover or tap reveal part of the content structure.
interactions.reuse: Use for service grids where a single static card would either feel too shallow or too dense.

interactions.title: CTA ripple behavior
interactions.study: Buttons use border, ripple, and text-offset layers so basic calls to action inherit the same motion language as the rest of the site.
interactions.reuse: Make CTA motion consistent with the larger stage vocabulary instead of introducing one-off button effects.

implementation.format: HTML-first scroll experience with custom cursor, video loops, and overlay navigation
implementation.notes: Static inspection exposed a rich DOM structure with loader, navbar overlay, card stacks, repeated reels, cursor-mode markers, and many autoplay media loops, which is enough to treat this as an accepted seed reference.
